en.question: I use <<15519>>'s『Special Summon from your Extra Deck, 1 [...] "Xyz Dragon" Xyz Monster [...]. (This is treated as an Xyz Summon. Transfer its materials to the Summoned monster.)』effect to Special Summon <<15520>>. Can I now activate <<22986>>'s『if you Xyz Summon an "Xyz Dragon" monster』effect?
